summary.result: The night time temperature of experimental greenhouse cooled by heat pump system could be maintained 4~6 $^{\circ}C$ lower than that of control greenhouse which was almost equal to outside air temperature.
summary.background: The coefficients of performance (COP) of heat pump itself and total heat pump system were approximately 2.71~2.88 and 1.99~2.22, respectively. 2.
